name: Conjunction Assessment Plugin
description: Conjunction assessment and collision probability analysis through the SDS PIV/TAB invoke surface.

inputPorts.description: Empirical prediction-error model for element-set sources: one $ERM whose MODEL arm gives the regimes and age bins (STRATA_SETTINGS) and per stratum the RTN position-velocity covariance (CLIPPED.COVARIANCE, else COVARIANCE, Lower21 km and km/s), with CALIBRATION and CALIBRATION_REFERENCE (analysis/gp-error-model; scripts/uncertainty-model.mjs from the model JSON). With a covariance ALGORITHM, each event between two element sets takes the covariance of its regime and prediction age (TCA minus epoch), labelled EMPIRICAL_MODEL and CALIBRATED only where the stratum is Calibrated; absent, or outside the model, events keep the Alfano maximum.

inputPorts.description: WINDOW_REQUEST on a resident index (prepare_screening_index and its siblings) with no primaries: ALFANO_MAXIMUM controls (window, coarse step, threshold, workers) in the index frame. Sources are mean elements (SGP4) or trajectories from any propagator (PPE in UTC, TT or TDB).
$SCR BLOCK: FIRST_STEP and STEP_COUNT (1-256) of the window's coarse steps.

outputPorts.description: $SCR GRID: the block's coarse states (x, y, z, deviation bound, vx, vy, vz per step and object, km and km/s, in the index frame) and each object's radius band; the GPU screen kernel input, and search_grid's.
$SCR SEARCH_REPORT: the block, the window's last step, the objects, and the objects SGP4 cannot propagate in the block (INDEX, FIRST_FAILURE_JD, REASON), to pass to refine_candidates.

inputPorts.description: WINDOW_REQUEST on a resident index (prepare_screening_index and its siblings) with no primaries: ALFANO_MAXIMUM controls (window, coarse step, threshold, workers) in the index frame. Sources are mean elements (SGP4) or trajectories from any propagator (PPE in UTC, TT or TDB).
$SCR BLOCK: FIRST_STEP and STEP_COUNT (1-65535) of the window's coarse steps.

outputPorts.description: $SCR CANDIDATES: the (OBJECT1, OBJECT2, STEP) cells that survive the coarse filter, by step then pair.
$SCR SEARCH_REPORT: the block, the window's last step, the objects, the exclusions and CANDIDATE_COUNT.

methods.description: The candidates of a block of coarse steps, found in the module without a GPU: the CPU counterpart of coarse_grid plus the GPU search. Returns the $SCR CANDIDATES refine_candidates takes.

inputPorts.description: WINDOW_REQUEST whose controls give the window, coarse step, threshold and workers; its index is not consulted (the grid holds every state the search reads).
$SCR GRID as coarse_grid returned it: one row per object. Non-finite rows (objects coarse_grid excluded) are not searched.
$SCR ROLES, one per grid object (Secondary, Primary, Skip); a pair is searched when one member is a primary and neither is skipped. Absent: every pair (all-vs-all).

outputPorts.description: $SCR CANDIDATES in grid rows, by step then pair.
$SCR SEARCH_REPORT: the block, the window's last step, the objects by role and CANDIDATE_COUNT.

methods.description: The candidates of a stored coarse grid block, found in the module: the CPU counterpart of the GPU search, optionally scoped by roles (incremental screening of updated objects, or one block of a partitioned screen). The f32 rounding of each row is bounded and added to its deviation bound, so the candidates contain every pair-step search_candidates finds on the same sources and roles; refine_candidates re-tests each in f64, on an index of the grid rows or of the rows the candidates name, in grid order.

inputPorts.description: WINDOW_REQUEST on a resident index (prepare_screening_index and its siblings) with no primaries: ALFANO_MAXIMUM controls (window, coarse step, threshold, workers) in the index frame. Sources are mean elements (SGP4) or trajectories from any propagator (PPE in UTC, TT or TDB).
$SCR CANDIDATES; absent scans every pair on the CPU.
$SCR EXCLUSIONS: the objects coarse_grid reported excluded over the window (INDEX, FIRST_FAILURE_JD).

inputPorts.description: $SCR POSSIBILITY_REQUEST: two admissible sets at a common epoch near the encounter (finite supports or ellipsoidal kernels, SI), the combined hard-body radius, the half window and the alpha levels.

outputPorts.description: $SCR POSSIBILITY_RESULT: possibility and necessity of collision, the miss-distance and closest-approach-time ranges, and each alpha-cut's ranges.

methods.description: Screening admissible trajectories by possibility and necessity (ASO catalog whitepaper section 12; TEAG N(A) = 1 - Pi(A^c)): finite supports with possibilities (pairs' rectilinear closest approach within the window; joint possibility min(pi_a, pi_b)) or ellipsoidal sets with Gaussian-shaped possibility kernels (minimum-trace outer bound of the Minkowski sum, evaluated in the encounter plane at the nominal closest approach). Possibility and necessity are not collision probabilities; finite supports screen only the encounters they sample.
